coverage: All seven stories and accompanying verse: human and animal protagonists, family ties, named herds and packs, local participants, reported figures and allusions.

entities.name: Mowgli
entities.body: The human raised by wolves, at the center of the first three jungle stories.

entities.name: Kotick
entities.body: The white fur seal, son of Sea Catch and Matkah.

entities.name: Rikki-tikki-tavi
entities.body: The mongoose living with Teddy’s family, the main character of the bungalow story.

entities.name: Little Toomai
entities.body: The young son of the elephant driver Big Toomai.

snapshots.name: Toomai of the Elephants
snapshots.body: Big Toomai’s young son, honored as Toomai of the Elephants.

entities.name: Father Wolf
entities.body: The wolf who raises Mowgli with Mother Wolf.

entities.name: Mother Wolf
entities.body: Mowgli’s wolf mother, also called Raksha.

entities.name: Bagheera
entities.body: The black panther, Mowgli’s friend and protector.

entities.name: Baloo
entities.body: The bear who teaches Mowgli the Law of the Jungle.

entities.name: Shere Khan
entities.body: The lame tiger, the chief enemy of Mowgli and his wolf family.

entities.name: Kaa
entities.body: The great rock python of the jungle.

entities.name: Gray Brother
entities.body: Mother Wolf’s eldest cub and Mowgli’s wolf brother.

entities.name: Sea Catch
entities.body: Kotick’s father, a large fighting fur seal.

entities.name: Matkah
entities.body: Kotick’s mother and Sea Catch’s mate.

entities.name: Nag
entities.body: The cobra in Teddy’s garden, Nagaina’s mate.

entities.name: Nagaina
entities.body: The female cobra, Nag’s mate.

entities.name: Darzee
entities.body: The tailorbird living in the garden with his mate.

entities.name: Darzee’s wife
entities.body: The female tailorbird, Darzee’s mate.

entities.name: Kala Nag
entities.body: The experienced elephant cared for by the Toomai family.

entities.name: Billy
entities.body: The experienced mule carrying the breech-piece for a mountain gun.

entities.name: The troop horse
entities.body: Dick Cunliffe’s Australian cavalry horse, Number Fifteen of the Ninth Lancers.

entities.name: Two Tails
entities.body: The elephant working with the siege-gun teams.

entities.name: The baggage camel
entities.body: The camel from the 39th Native Infantry talking with the other camp animals.

entities.name: Akela
entities.body: The lone wolf who leads the Seeonee pack.

snapshots.body: The former leader of the Seeonee wolf pack, an ally of Mowgli.

entities.name: The Bandar-log
entities.body: The monkey people of the jungle.

entities.name: The gun bullocks
entities.body: The pair of oxen from Hapur who pull the heavy siege guns.

entities.name: Tabaqui
entities.body: The jackal who scavenges near the wolves and carries news.

entities.name: Rann
entities.body: The kite who flies over the jungle.

entities.name: Mang
entities.body: The bat named among the jungle animals.

entities.name: Ikki
entities.body: The porcupine who brings jungle gossip.

entities.name: Mao
entities.body: The peacock named among the jungle creatures.

entities.name: Hathi
entities.body: The wild elephant whose authority is recognized in the jungle.

entities.name: The Seeonee wolf pack
entities.body: The wolves who meet at Council Rock and follow the Law of the Jungle.

entities.name: Mother Wolf’s cubs
entities.body: The four wolf cubs raised alongside Mowgli.

entities.name: Messua
entities.body: The village woman whose son Nathoo was taken by a tiger.

entities.name: Buldeo
entities.body: The village hunter who tells stories about the jungle.

entities.name: Kamya
entities.body: One of the village boys tending cattle with Mowgli.

entities.name: Rama
entities.body: The great buffalo bull at the head of Mowgli’s herd.

entities.name: The village priest
entities.body: The priest who speaks with Messua when Mowgli arrives.

entities.name: The village headman
entities.body: One of the elders gathered beneath the village tree.

entities.name: The village watchman
entities.body: The watchman among the men telling stories beneath the tree.

entities.name: The village barber
entities.body: The barber who shares the village gossip.

entities.name: Messua’s husband
entities.body: The wealthy villager married to Messua.

entities.name: The village potter
entities.body: The maker of pots whose donkey Mowgli helps.

entities.name: The potter’s donkey
entities.body: The animal Mowgli helps out of the clay pit.

entities.name: Limmershin
entities.body: The winter wren who tells the narrator Kotick’s story.

entities.name: The narrator
entities.body: The human storyteller who recounts the animals’ experiences.

entities.name: Kerick Booterin
entities.body: The chief of the seal hunters on Saint Paul Island, Patalamon’s father.

entities.name: Patalamon
entities.body: Kerick Booterin’s son, helping with the seal hunt.

entities.name: Sea Lion
entities.body: The sea lion Kotick consults near the seal grounds.

entities.name: Sea Vitch
entities.body: The large walrus whom Kotick consults.

entities.name: The sea cows
entities.body: The silent sea mammals that graze on underwater plants.

entities.name: Sea Pig
entities.body: The porpoise leading the school that Kotick follows.

entities.name: The albatross
entities.body: The old bird who suggests an island for Kotick to visit.

entities.name: The old seal of Masafuera
entities.body: The elderly survivor of a lost seal rookery whom Kotick meets.

entities.name: Kotick’s companion
entities.body: The female seal who dances with Kotick and waits for him.

entities.name: The challenging seal
entities.body: The young seal who questions Kotick’s right to direct the others.

entities.name: The holluschickie
entities.body: The young bachelor seals on the breeding beaches.

entities.name: The Burgomaster gull
entities.body: The gull who mocks Sea Vitch and answers Kotick.

entities.name: Chuchundra
entities.body: The timid muskrat who gives Rikki advice and keeps close to the walls.

entities.name: Karait
entities.body: The small, venomous snake in Teddy’s garden.

entities.name: Teddy
entities.body: The English boy whose family takes in Rikki.

entities.name: Alice
entities.body: Teddy’s mother.

entities.name: Teddy’s father
entities.body: The Englishman living with Alice and Teddy in the bungalow.

entities.name: The Coppersmith
entities.body: The bird whose ringing call carries news through the garden.

entities.name: Big Toomai
entities.body: Little Toomai’s father and Kala Nag’s driver.

entities.name: Petersen Sahib
entities.body: The official in charge of the government’s elephant-catching operations.

entities.name: Machua Appa
entities.body: The chief elephant tracker in Petersen Sahib’s force.

entities.name: Pudmini
entities.body: Petersen Sahib’s female elephant.

entities.name: Gunga Pershad
entities.body: One of the elephants addressed at the camp salute.

entities.name: Hira Guj
entities.body: One of the elephants named at the camp salute.

entities.name: Birchi Guj
entities.body: One of the elephants named at the camp salute.

entities.name: Kuttar Guj
entities.body: One of the elephants named at the camp salute.

entities.name: Little Toomai’s mother
entities.body: The mother singing to Little Toomai’s younger brother in the camp.

entities.name: Little Toomai’s brother
entities.body: The small child being soothed by his mother’s lullaby.

entities.name: The pay clerk
entities.body: The official paying the elephant drivers at the camp.

entities.name: Vixen
entities.body: The narrator’s fox terrier.

entities.name: The young mule
entities.body: The frightened recruit in Billy’s mountain-gun battery.

entities.name: The Amir of Afghanistan
entities.body: The Afghan ruler visiting the military review.

entities.name: The Viceroy of India
entities.body: The British imperial official hosting the military review.

entities.name: The Central Asian chief
entities.body: The visitor accompanying the Amir who asks how the military animals are controlled.

entities.name: The Indian officer
entities.body: The officer explaining the chain of command to the visiting chief.

entities.name: Shiva
entities.body: The god called Shiv and Mahadeo in the lullaby about feeding all creatures.

entities.name: Parbati
entities.body: Shiva’s wife in the lullaby, also known as Parvati.

entities.name: The grasshopper
entities.body: The small creature hidden by Parbati in the lullaby.

entities.name: Nathoo
entities.body: Messua’s missing son; she sees a resemblance between him and Mowgli.

entities.name: Purun Dass
entities.body: The deceased moneylender in Buldeo’s story about the tiger.

entities.name: Bagheera’s mother
entities.body: The panther who died in captivity, recalled by Bagheera.

entities.name: Rikki’s mother
entities.body: The mongoose mother whose advice Rikki remembers.

entities.name: Rikki’s father
entities.body: Rikki’s mongoose father, mentioned with his mother.

entities.name: Chua
entities.body: Chuchundra’s cousin, a rat.

entities.name: Radha Pyari
entities.body: Kala Nag’s mother, the elephant whose advice he remembers.

entities.name: Black Toomai
entities.body: Big Toomai’s father, who took Kala Nag to Abyssinia.

entities.name: The earlier Toomai of the Elephants
entities.body: Big Toomai’s grandfather, who saw Kala Nag captured.

entities.name: Emperor Theodore
entities.body: The Ethiopian ruler recalled in the account of Kala Nag’s military service.

entities.name: Dick Cunliffe
entities.body: The cavalry trooper who rides the Australian troop horse.

entities.name: Sunol
entities.body: The celebrated trotting horse used as a comparison for the cavalry horse’s pride in breeding.

entities.name: Carbine
entities.body: The Melbourne Cup winner whom the cavalry horse claims as a relative.

entities.name: The Empress
entities.body: Queen Victoria, the imperial sovereign at the top of the chain of command described in the story.

entities.name: Alexander
entities.body: Alexander the Great, invoked in the elephants’ marching song.

entities.name: Hercules
entities.body: The classical hero invoked as an image of strength in the elephants’ song.

entities.name: Cupid
entities.body: The god of love, mentioned in the monkeys’ song.

entities.name: The Frog Footman
entities.body: The frog servant from Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland, evoked by the sea cows’ bowing.

entities.name: Brahm
entities.body: Brahma, the god in Nag’s story about the cobra’s hood-mark.

entities.name: Tweedle-dum and Tweedle-dee
entities.body: The paired comic names invoked in the heading’s contrast between two ways of doing things.
